# AI Customer Support Software

> The site has four pages: the ranked answer (index.html), methodology, about, and a pricing comparison. It ranks 12 real products. The top three are Zendesk AI Agents, Fin by Intercom and Salesforce Agentforce for Service. After them come Sierra, Decagon, Freshdesk Freddy AI, Ada, Gorgias, HubSpot Customer Agent, Kustomer, Forethought and Help Scout. All facts come from public sources read on 2026-11-09, mostly vendor pages. Fix from review: I checked the Salesforce prices myself on Salesforce's Agentforce pricing page. The browser read was blocked, but a plain read worked. The page confirms $2 per conversation and Flex Credits at $500 per 100,000 credits. Its own examples work out to $0.10 per standard action and $0.15 per voice action. It also lists the $125 per user/month Agentforce add-on, a $5 Agentforce User License, and Max Edition from $550 per user/month with 2.75M Flex Credits. Two sources could not be checked. The add-on PDF link now redirects to the general pricing page, and the Flex Credits blog post is blocked. I removed both from sources and from the site's claims. I downloaded the February 2026 rate card PDF, but I could not read its text, so it is not cited. I also dropped the claim that the add-on is 'billed annually' as an add-on term. Salesforce's general pricing FAQ only says most subscriptions are paid annually in advance. Other caveats: (1) The order is editorial judgment, not testing or benchmarks, and the site says so. (2) Ada's pricing page was blocked, so its pricing model comes from its customer terms. (3) Gorgias prices come from its own 2026 pricing guides, because the live pricing cards were not readable. (4) Some figures are marked unpublished: Zendesk's per-resolution rate, and list prices for Sierra, Decagon, Ada, Kustomer and Forethought. (5) Zendesk completed its purchase of Forethought on 2026-03-26. (6) The Related guides line links each of these once: bestaicustomersupport.com, bestaisupportagent.com, bestaiphoneagent.com. (7) No files were written to out/attachments; all content is below.

- [AI Customer Support Software: The 12 Best Options in 2026](https://aicustomersupportsoftware.com/): Independent, sourced ranking of the best AI customer support software in 2026: Zendesk, Fin, Salesforce Agentforce, Sierra, Decagon, Freshdesk and more.
- [AI Customer Support Software Pricing Compared (2026)](https://aicustomersupportsoftware.com/ai-customer-support-pricing.html): Published 2026 pricing for AI customer support software: per-resolution, per-outcome, per-conversation and seat prices for Zendesk, Fin, Salesforce, Gorgias and more.
- [How We Research and Rank AI Customer Support Software](https://aicustomersupportsoftware.com/methodology.html): Our plain-language methodology: official vendor sources, dated research, and ranking criteria for AI customer support software. No hands-on testing claims.
- [About AI Customer Support Software](https://aicustomersupportsoftware.com/about.html): About aicustomersupportsoftware.com: an independent research site summarizing public, sourced information on AI customer support software.
